commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. The knight-captain tomb at Eurydike needs proof; his disc bears the mark of Vicrium, a mine behind Seafalls, where the knights kept a strongbox. I must find it before the Unbound and the Collector. 2. Get into the lower galleries of Vicrium and search the knights strongbox. 3. Get the key from Ah-Zish by good words or 100 gold, or lift it from him; take the old lower adit through water with crocodiles; fight or sneak past the smugglers. 4. I do not know what the Root and the Eye really are, or how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows. I could ask people and read what I find.
use Door to Old Lower Adit
pick Door to Lower Galleries win

answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. I got into the lower galleries of Vicrium (the key had to be lifted from Ah-Zish) and found in the knights strongbox an old parchment map showing seven towers standing in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island. 2. Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Go straight there via the marker; I could also study the map first. No other choice is visible. 4. I do not know what the seven towers or the tooth-shaped crag island are, nor the Root and the Eye. Nesh-Deeka may explain.

answer 1. I gave Nesh-Deeka the map. She says her officer will read it. She knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium, saying only "we listen". She named me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, and paid 200 gold. 2. Choose the orders gift, a rapier or a quarterstaff, from Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Take the rapier or the quarterstaff. 4. I still do not understand how she listens, what the seven towers and tooth crag are, or the Root and the Eye. Her officer or further talk may tell.

answer 1. I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka passes me to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, whom I now report to. 2. Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice in the same room in Helstrom. 3. Just talk to her; nothing else is offered. 4. Still unknown: the seven towers, the tooth crag, the Root and the Eye, how the order listens. Never-Writes-Twice may tell.

answer 1. The map shows the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha; Never-Writes-Twice marked it. She warned me off Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former order member gone mad on sap who killed her minders. 2. Nothing more is set; the quest is complete. Likely next: Skeith Isle via Archon and Arorha. 3. Follow the Grey Tooth lead, or return to the Eurydike tomb task. 4. Unknown: the seven towers, the Root and the Eye, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is now, how the order listens.

answer I work for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom and am now Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, and I report to her officer Never-Writes-Twice. I paid and persuaded Ah-Zish but the key never reached my pack. I had to pickpocket it, and that worked. I took the old parchment map from the knights strongbox at Vicrium: seven towers in the sea and a tooth crag. Never-Writes-Twice says the crag is the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha, and she marked it. I carry the rapier, the map, and about 900 gold by my own count, though the journal listed 0 gold. I also carry the keystone and other items from before. Beware Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former order member gone mad on sap. Still unknown: the Root, the Eye, the seven towers, how the order listens. The Eurydike tomb near Gideon is still pending, with the Unbound and the Collector competing.
